events.headline: Trump rejects Iran's proposal to fully reopen the Strait of Hormuz and denies sanctions-relief talk; Saudi Arabia has restored roughly half of its East-West pipeline flows (~3.5M bbl/day to the Red Sea) bypassing Hormuz, easing but not resolving Mideast supply risk
Chip stocks rally sharply: AMD and Intel each up ~29% in September, SOXX semiconductor ETF up ~11% this month heading for its strongest month since June, driven by AI infrastructure demand
August PCE inflation (Fed's preferred gauge) rose less than expected (0.3% m/m, 3.4% y/y vs 3.7% forecast), causing traders to cut odds of an October Fed rate hike to ~36% from roughly coin-toss

China's suspension of its Oct 2025 rare-earth, lithium-battery and critical-materials export controls (paused through Nov 10, 2026) remains in effect, continuing to ease near-term supply-chain disruption risk though the pause is nearing expiration
